title: A part sale is one Part Sales row holding the whole sale
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active staff member at the test location with the "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Make sure the test location's Shop Supplies Charge is 0% and nothing else is invoiced at the test location today.
  • Have a first part sale for that customer with one part at $80.00 and shop supplies of $5.00.
  • Have a second part sale for that customer with one part at $40.00 and no shop supplies charge.
  • Have a third part sale for that customer with one part at $30.00 and a shop supplies charge of $0.00.
  • On all three part sales set Sales Representative to sales rep A, and invoice all three today.
  • Open Reports > Sales By Representative in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide, with the date range set to today and the Sales Type column turned on.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Each part sale is one row with Sales Type "Part Sales" holding every dollar.
  • The first part sale shows $80.00 of parts with Shop Supplies $5.00.
  • The second part sale shows $40.00 with Shop Supplies showing a dash.
  • The third part sale shows $30.00 with Shop Supplies $0.00.
  • On all three rows Labor Delta, Labor Invoiced and Labor Margin show a dash, not 0.00 or $0.00.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative)

  • S5-R9: “A part sale is one "Part Sales" row holding every dollar of the invoice.”
  • S5-R15a: “On a Part Sales row, Shop Supplies shows the part sale's shop supplies, or a dash when the part sale has no shop supplies charge. $0.00 shows only when a shop supplies charge of $0.00 is on it.”
  • S5-R15b: “On a Part Sales row, Labor Delta, Labor Invoiced and Labor Margin, and the labor and hours cells of the Expanded downloads, show a dash on screen and in the PDF and are blank in the CSV. A part sale has no labor, so these columns don't apply to it.”
  • S5-R3: “The report reads every invoice as one row per representative per Sales Type: "Labor" for a work order's labor side, "Parts" for its parts side, and "Part Sales" for a part sale.”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (answers 1 to 38, 19 Oct 2026; answers 39 and 40, 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 25: “25. (a) A dash when the part sale has no shop supplies; $0.00 only when it has a shop supplies line that totals $0.00. The design's $0.00 is a sample-data mistake.”
  • Chris Ward's answer 39: “39. (a) A dash on screen and in the PDF, and an empty cell in the CSV, as the design shows. A part sale has no labor, so the labor columns don't apply to it; it's the same rule as answers 24 and 25. This changes today's 0.00 / $0.00, so it's now listed under Release day. New S5-R15b, PRD v11.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
